verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Nitro page listing "HD video streaming" as a perk, which implies Discord has its own live video streaming. Voice chat is also documented, but only as a Social SDK feature for game developers. Nothing explicitly describes sharing a screen during a call, so delivery of this story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screen sharing in voice/video calls, details on how participants view and collaborate on a shared screen, free-tier availability versus the Nitro-only HD perk, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
